name: Chika to Ore to Satomi-san no Yoru
original_name: 千夏とオレと里美さんの夜
source:
One day, you, a private teacher of a girl, was spotted as having sex with the student's mother in her home (in fact, you already had sexual relationship with the student too) ....My life is over. You were completely devastated, but.....

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE022677.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
